sections.title: Bringing Unit 15 together
sections.content: This lesson pulls together Unit 15: planning a trip with foglal and csomagol, station and airport vocabulary, describing travel problems with van/nincs, and using ha ..., akkor ... to talk about what happens if something goes wrong.

sections.title: Travel, recapped
rows: to be late, to miss, to break down

items.spanish: Szeretek utazni, mert imádom az új élményeket.
items.english: I like to travel, because I love new experiences.

items.spanish: Ha késik a vonatunk, akkor lekéssük a csatlakozást.
items.english: If our train is late, then we'll miss the connection.

items.spanish: Van egy problémánk: elromlott a bőröndöm kereke.
items.english: We have a problem: my suitcase's wheel broke.

sections.content: For a real condition, ha ..., akkor ... works with plain present tense in both halves, exactly like the ha-clauses for weather. akkor is optional — you can drop it and just keep the comma.
